title: 7 Things Research Shows About NMN After 40
meta_description: What human NMN trials measured after 40: NAD+ levels, walking speed, sleep, and the outcomes that did not move. Plus why NMN is often paired with TMG.

hero.title: Research Shows About NMN After 40
hero.summary_html: Summary: NMN is everywhere in longevity talk. Here is what human trials measured, what moved, what didn't, and why NMN is so often paired with TMG.

items.title: NMN is a NAD+ building block
items.body:
NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide) is a molecule your body can turn into NAD+, a coenzyme your cells use to make energy.

So the real question is simple: does swallowing NMN raise NAD+ in people? Several trials tested exactly that.
items.alt: Morning routine at a kitchen table: a glass of water and two plain white capsules in a small dish

items.title: NAD+ rose 38% in 60 days
items.body:
In a placebo-controlled trial of 66 adults aged 40 to 65, the NMN group's blood NAD+/NADH was up 11% at day 30 and 38% at day 60.

Placebo rose 14.3% by day 60. Note what was measured: a blood marker, not energy or mood.

chart.title: Blood NAD+/NADH, change from baseline
chart.source: Huang et al., Front Aging 2022. 66 adults aged 40 to 65, 60 days, NMN vs placebo.

items.title: Faster walking in older adults
items.body:
In a 12-week trial of older adults, the NMN group finished a 4-meter walk faster than placebo and had higher blood NAD+. Sleep scores improved too.

Honest caveat: the main outcome, a stepping test, showed no difference. Walking and sleep were secondary results in one small study.
items.alt: Two older adults walking briskly on a leafy park path, seen from behind

items.title: The bigger picture is mixed
items.body:
A 2025 meta-analysis pooled 12 randomized trials with 513 people. NMN reliably raised blood NAD+.

But most health markers, like fasting glucose and cholesterol, did not beat placebo. The authors warn that NMN's benefits may be exaggerated.
items.evidence: Meta-analysis (12 RCTs, 513 people), Crit Rev Food Sci Nutr 2025

chart.title: Meta-analysis: 12 trials, 513 people
chart.source: Zhang, Poon, Wong. Crit Rev Food Sci Nutr 2025;65(22):4382-4400.

items.title: Why TMG is paired with NMN
items.body:
Your body clears leftover nicotinamide partly by methylation. In the walking trial, those methylated by-products rose with NMN.

TMG (betaine) is a methyl donor. In healthy adults, daily betaine lowered homocysteine, a methylation marker, within six weeks (Olthof 2003).
items.evidence: Human trial (RCT, TMG only), J Nutr 2003
items.alt: A leafy spinach and chickpea salad bowl on a wooden table

items.title: No combined trial yet
items.body:
Every trial here tested NMN alone or TMG alone. We found no published human trial of the two combined.

So the pairing rests on each ingredient's separate evidence. Unproven as a pair is not the same as unproven at all.
items.evidence: Evidence gap — literature search, no combined-trial citation to give
items.alt: A stack of printed research papers, a highlighter and reading glasses: checking the published trials

items.title: Trials tested daily use
items.body:
Every trial above dosed people daily for weeks or months (see sources). None tested taking it now and then.

So the best format is the one you will actually take every day.
items.evidence: Study-design pattern across the trials above
items.alt: A daily morning routine on the kitchen counter: coffee and a glass of water

bridge.title: Convenience is part of consistency
bridge.body:
